I should note that this reconciliation has not yet been placed in the legal matter file, but it directly affects the scale of any litigation or commercial response we recommend.

Martin, the amendment requires a 30-day cure period before termination, arbitration in Dallas, and permits emergency injunctive relief — so we cannot terminate without notice, and our litigation forum is arbitration, not court. Sofia, the client's primary objective is preserving uninterrupted distributor deliveries, and we must include no admission of breach in whatever we pursue. Derek, the reconciliation reduces our supportable affirmative demand from $400,000 to $125,000 after applying the $275,000 credit — that fundamentally changes the scale of any litigation. All three findings are noted. I'm now prepared to approve a response consistent with these constraints. Let me formalize the decision.
